verification: 16 existing offline push-policy and email-campaign tests passed; no transport request or customer message. These test current behavior, not an implemented new alert feature.
goal: A concrete useful Pro extension without forcing marketing, adding model costs or promising unlimited free delivery.
recommendedOrder: Opt-in local reminders for saved offers
Personalized saved-search alerts after capacity and consent verification

currentCodeEvidence.currentBehavior: Pro daily selection at09 Vienna with seven-day repeat suppression; optional Wednesday/Sunday18 digests; invitation and trial reminders separate. Legacy Free marketing policy exists. This preparation does not alter any schedule or consent.
currentCodeEvidence.configurationCaveat: Repository flags are not proof of deployed flags, current provider tokens, recipient counts or delivery. docs/push-config.json is web-push configuration, not evidence native APNs/FCM are off.
currentCodeEvidence.offlineEligibility: Of65 current local live records, existing strict daily-push policy accepts4 and excludes61: unverified_dates25, not_approved20, not_food_or_drink10, restricted_hours5, unsafe_copy1. First-failure categories, not proof the other offers are invalid. Remote overrides and deployed DO were not included.

phase1LocalFavorites.experience: Existing Favorites remain free. A Pro user may explicitly enable a bell on one saved deal, choose a reminder time, see the scheduled time and cancel it.
phase1LocalFavorites.timing: For a reliably dated offer suggest the previous evening or a user-selected time before expiry. Explicit dated time windows may be supported; unknown expiry is never guessed. For unknown end dates offer a user-chosen reminder with no claim it is expiring.
phase1LocalFavorites.delivery: Use OS-local notifications, not Resend, KV polling or per-recipient server pushes. Works without an active network after scheduling, subject to OS settings and delivery behavior; no guaranteed exact minute.
safety: Schedule only after an explicit user choice and OS permission; never turn an existing No into Yes.
Cancel on unfavorite, user-disable, known hidden/expired offer, logout where applicable or verified loss of Pro. Reconcile pending requests on app foreground/feed update.
An offline device cannot learn a newly withdrawn deal. Copy must say check current availability; never promise free food or guaranteed redemption.
Do not request Android exact-alarm permission for marketing. Bound pending reminders (proposed20) and persist stable opaque IDs, including community IDs containing colons.
Do not expose private favorites to the backend solely to implement a local reminder.
phase1LocalFavorites.effortEstimate: Approximately2-3 engineering days across both native platforms plus sequential small/large-text/light/dark and notification tests; estimate, not a delivery promise. New Store release required.

phase2SavedSearchAlerts.experience: Profile > Angebotsalarme: saved concrete foods/categories, optional merchant, manually selected districts and optional maximum price only where a numeric price is reliable. No location permission required for district selection.
matchRules: Only approved current public records, not pending Slack candidates; exact benefit and eligibility remain visible.
First enrollment does not blast historical inventory. Trigger on genuinely new matched offers or material verified changes, deduped across post URLs.
Prefer grouping into one personal digest; proposed maximum1 per day and3 per week, quiet hours21-09 Vienna. These are a new proposal, not a change to existing twice-weekly consent.
Exclude misleading matches: alcohol, expired/future offers outside the chosen period, missing location, uncertain price, missing required membership.
Avoid duplicate notifications for the same offer across daily selection, personal alerts and favorite reminders. Store a bounded per-device event ledger.
phase2SavedSearchAlerts.consent: Separate in-app enabling control describing topic and frequency; preserve all existing choices. OS push permission alone is not new email or advertising consent. No email copy of the alert unless separately chosen and capacity verified.
phase2SavedSearchAlerts.implementation: Rule-based matching using existing structured data; no new AI. Extend server payload types and BOTH native allowlists deliberately; existing policy currently accepts only daily/digest types. Use versioned opt-in registrations, production transports and server recheck before send.
phase2SavedSearchAlerts.effortEstimate: Approximately3-5 additional engineering days for rule storage, validation, dedupe, bounded SQL queue and native controls, then release and monitored pilot; no activation in this task.

currentEmailGuard.includes: All app email attempts, including ambiguous outcomes, digests and reward notices. Not90 new recipients per feature.

capacity.emailDecision: Do not introduce daily personal emails. A day with90 already scheduled messages leaves0 attempts for new alerts. Current remaining provider quota and account usage were not read; limits were not increased.
capacity.currentPushQueue: SQL-backed Durable Object batches20 enabled devices, records a claim before transport, retains delivery/campaign data35days and removes devices older60days. Current implementation reloads source per batch and is not yet a personal-alert queue.
capacity.exampleNotCapacityProof: 1000 consenting recipients x1 additional alert require at least1000 transport attempts and, in the current claim/update pattern, about2000 delivery-row mutations, before SQL index accounting, cleanup, other features and shared quotas. This is arithmetic, not a verified available capacity or a cost guarantee.
capacity.activationGate: Read real production opt-in audiences, current CF request/SQL/duration usage, existing campaign load and transport readiness immediately before activation. Use offline fixtures for load tests. Keep30percent measured reserve, bounded batches and a fail-closed feature budget; no automatic paid upgrade.

acceptanceTestsBeforeRelease: Explicit yes/no, OS denial/revocation and old consent migrations preserve choices.
Unknown expiry, weekday restrictions, memberships, time zones and daylight-saving transitions never create a false availability claim.
Unfavorite/hide/update cancels or reconciles reminders; app restart and duplicate callbacks do not double-send.
Native payload/version tests for iOS and Android, community IDs, light/dark/large text and working deal deep link.
Provider accepted is logged separately from device receipt. Only an explicitly approved own-device test, never a mass test.
No extra email, API title editor, scraper run, live test fixture or remote consent change.
rollback: New features defaultoff behind separate flags; disabling stops new queue work while existing daily, digest, invitations and trial reminders continue. Pending optional local reminders are reconciled in app.
decision: Prepare local favorite reminders first; approve implementation separately. Do not activate personal server alerts until real capacity and versioned consent are verified.
